_note: open_top (DESIGN): the riders sit in the open (pickup bed and cab windows, boat, MLRS crew), so a warhead bursting on the vehicle reaches them in free air even when the plate stops it.

Unarmored vehicle: sheet metal is 0.5 mm RHA on every face (the user's value, 2026-10-25), not converted from a sourced figure: car outer skins are 0.6-0.8 mm sheet steel (see sources) and no sourced mild-steel-to-RHA factor was found.

Engine: 12 mm (DESIGN): an engine block is cover against rifle ball (the small-arms model derives 9-10 mm of mild steel for 5.56/7.62) but not against .50 BMG (17 mm), as the user asked for a thicker engine.
'soft': small-arms rounds without an armor_penetration value use the mild-steel penetration the small-arms model derives for them (ballistics/smallarms/SteelPenetration) instead of being stopped.
OBB 1 is the hull: its rear face is the engine at the stern.
